units: Taan. 8ᵇ כמין ק׳ יש וכ׳ there is a sort of room in heaven from which the rains proceed; (Yalk. Ps. 789 קורה web; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8).
<cite ref="Menachot 31b:6">Men. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא יעשנה כק׳</he> that he do not write the door-post inscription in the shape of an arch.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17b">Ab. Zar. 17ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>על בתו לישב בק׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בק׳ של זונות</he>) his daughter was condemned to sit in a brothel.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>שמא בק׳ הוא</he> (some ed. <he>בקובא</he>) perhaps he (Joseph) is in a brothel (sold, for sodomy); a. e.
